problem.title: 風險不只在模型說了什麼，而在系統真的做了什麼。
problem.description: 當 AI Agent 可以寄信、查詢資料、修改系統或呼叫 MCP 工具，安全工作必須從文字過濾延伸到多步軌跡、權限、實際 action outcome 與版本重測。

items.title: 危險動作先於答案
items.description: Agent 可能在產生看似正常的最終文字前，就已提出外傳、寄送、刪除或執行動作。

items.title: 版本漂移讓結論失效
items.description: 模型、Prompt、Tool Schema、MCP 或權限一更新，一次性測試結果就可能不再成立。

items.title: Trace 與營運證據分散
items.description: AI、AppSec、SOC 與稽核團隊缺少共同的 action trace、決策理由與重測證據。

items.title: 直接阻擋可能影響營運
items.description: 未經驗證的自動阻擋可能誤傷正常流程，因此需要 observe-first、人工核准與漸進 enforcement。

platform.title: 同一套 SenseL，把安全營運與 Agent 行動驗證連成閉環。
platform.description: SenseL 將 IT、OT、Edge 與 Agent／MCP 軌跡，連同 Episode Evidence、AI 推論、安全驗證與改善追蹤，設計成同一個 Control & Validation Plane。

steps.title: Contextualize
steps.description: 資產、身分、權限、網路、資料流與業務脈絡

steps.title: Reason
steps.description: AI 關聯、風險排序與攻擊故事

steps.title: Validate
steps.description: 情境、Replay、Purple Team 與版本回歸測試

steps.title: Improve
steps.description: 修正、工單、重測與基線更新

platform.highlight: 多數工具止於 Detection、Alert 或 Prompt 分類。SenseL 把訊號與 Agent action 轉化為可重播 Episode，再透過 Validation 證明控制與改善是否在指定版本及範圍內有效。

agentAssurance.title: 從一次付費評估，走向每次版本都能重跑的安全 release gate。
agentAssurance.description: Agent Assurance 共用 SenseL 的證據、驗證、On-Premise 與人工核准能力：Assess 找出 action-level 風險，Validate 將發現產品化，Gate 再以 observe-first 路徑進入執行前政策決策。

modules.title: SenseL Agent Assess
modules.description: 針對 Agent、Tool、MCP、權限、資料流與 Guardrail 進行有授權的攻擊面盤點、測試、修補建議與重測。

modules.title: SenseL Agent Replay / Validate
modules.description: 把已驗證的失敗固化為客戶專屬 regression pack，比較模型、Prompt、Tool Schema、Policy 與權限版本。

modules.title: SenseL Agent Gate
modules.description: 在工具執行前整合 Schema、Allowlist、身分權限、DLP 與軌跡風險；先觀察與校準，再依核准範圍逐步 enforcement。

modules.title: SenseL Agent Lens
modules.description: 針對可取得權重與 activation 的 self-hosted 模型，研究執行前 internal signal；不作為閉源 API 或核心 SLA 的前提。

items.title: 醫療 EDR：從分散告警到可追溯處置
items.summary: 串接既有 EDR 與資產脈絡，建立人工確認的事件流程、改善紀錄與隔離式重測。
items.challenge: 中型院所必須維持臨床服務連續性，但精實的 IT／資安團隊仍需研判大量端點告警。既有訊號缺少共同資產與身分脈絡，修正、通報與重測證據也散落於不同工具。
approach: 先接入既有 EDR，不以全面汰換為前提
把事件正規化為版本化 Episode，補上資產、身分與核准脈絡
AI 協助摘要與排序，事件定性及高風險動作仍由人員確認
驗證與重測限定於隔離或院方核准的低干擾環境
outcomes: 建立 EDR 接入與資料健康基線
形成跨來源 Episode 與事件升級流程
保留改善追蹤與重測證據包
讓管理報告與治理證據採用一致格式

items.summary: 整合 CT、Gateway 與設備資料，建立能源基線、資料品質與 OT 安全擴充路徑。
items.challenge: 能源 CT 與 Gateway 資料可能停留在快照、試算表或分離系統，設備階層與感測器映射也不完整。能源與 OT 資安團隊因此缺少共同脈絡，而正式產線不能承受未經核准的主動測試或自動控制。
approach: 以被動接入與 On-Premise 路徑為優先
為 CT／MQTT／Gateway 資料建立版本、品質狀態、設備階層與血緣
形成 EnB、EnPI、M&V 與管理審查素材
AI 用於關聯與排序，不直接控制設備；OT 驗證採 observe-first
outcomes: 建立 CT 與設備資料映射及品質報告
由一次性快照走向連續基線與異常檢視
形成可追溯的 M&V 與管理審查素材
保留 OT Security 與受控 Validation 擴充路徑

items.title: 中小企業：快速建立供應鏈資安基線
items.summary: 從關鍵資產與客戶要求開始，串接防護訊號，產出改善清單與可交付證據。
items.challenge: 中小企業經常以精實 IT 團隊承接大型客戶或供應鏈資安要求，卻缺少自建 SOC 的人力與流程。問卷、控制要求、工具告警與改善證據彼此分離。
approach: 界定關鍵流程、對外連線、資產、帳號與必要控制證據
串接既有或預設 EDR／NDR／WAF／Identity 並建立資料健康基線
以 AI 輔助且人工確認的方式進行事件分級與改善排序
將供應鏈要求映射到實際控制、證據與重測節奏
outcomes: 形成現況成熟度基線與資產控制地圖
建立優先改善清單及事件升級手冊
產出管理與客戶可使用的證據包
以分階段路線降低一次到位自建 SOC 的門檻

agentAssurancePage.title: 保護真正會發生的動作，而不只檢查提示詞。
agentAssurancePage.summary: SenseL Agent Assurance 將 Agent、Tool、MCP、Identity、Permission 與 execution trace 納入既有 Validation Plane：先以可重播證據找出風險，再把修補轉成每次版本都能執行的 regression gate。
agentAssurancePage.problemTitle: 當 Agent 能改變系統狀態，文字分類已不足以證明安全。
agentAssurancePage.problemDescription: 真正的 ground truth 是危險工具是否被提出、放行與執行，以及修補後在相同版本邊界下能否重現驗證。

problems.title: Action 早於最終回答
problems.description: 資料外洩、寄信、付款、刪除或程式執行，可能在最終文字出現前就已被提出。

problems.title: 每次更新都可能漂移
problems.description: 模型、Prompt、RAG、Tool Schema、MCP Server 或權限變更，都可能使舊結論失效。

problems.title: 分類不等於實際阻擋
problems.description: Guard 判為 unsafe，不代表危險 action 沒有 fail-open；必須檢查實際 outcome。

problems.title: 敏感 Trace 不能任意外傳
problems.description: 軌跡可能包含個資、Credential、原始碼與企業流程，需要最小留存與受控部署。

agentAssurancePage.journeyTitle: 用服務取得真實證據，再把證據沉澱成 recurring product。
agentAssurancePage.journeyDescription: Assess 是固定範圍的商業入口；Replay／Validate 是第一個核心年約產品；Gate 只有在誤報、延遲與受控 Pilot 達標後才逐步 enforce；Lens 維持 open-weight 研究選項。

agentAssurancePage.architectureDescription: 每個步驟都綁定模型、Prompt、Tool、Policy 與權限版本；不把缺失證據補成事實，也不提供無邊界安全保證。

technologyPage.thesisTitle: 安全 AI 的價值，不在答案說得多快，而在答案能否被查證。
technologyPage.thesisDescription: 模型會變、資料會缺、場域會失聯。SenseL 的技術策略是先保住來源、版本、缺漏與權限，再讓 AI 在可追溯邊界內加速調查，最後用安全情境與重測證明改善是否有效。

items.title: SenseL RelayGuard
items.description: 在邊緣結合 EdgeX 主動遙測與 SPAN/TAP 被動流量感測，只向上傳送特徵摘要、安全事件與證據參考。
items.proof: 公開 MVP：OT 規則、IEC 61850、MQTT、Suricata／Snort bridge；SenseL OT Dashboard 整合仍在路線圖。

items.title: TrustEpisode
items.description: 研究如何把 EDR／NDR 調查封裝成版本化、可重播、可稽核的 Evidence Contract，讓缺漏保持缺漏，而不是由 AI 補寫。
items.proof: 公開研究 artifact；不代表論文已接受，也不代表所有契約已整合進正式 SenseL 產品。

items.title: AVLBench
items.description: 以凍結 manifest、fixture、checksum 與 Safe／Attack-enabled 分離條件，評估 AI 輔助安全驗證是否可以被第三方重算。
items.proof: R0 artifact verification 與 R1 fixture recomputation 可公開執行；R2 實機路徑仍需授權 Lab。

items.title: EviGrid
items.description: 研究如何把 IEC 61850 威脅與 CVE 轉成受控驗證假設，並以 MMS／GOOSE 基線與 fail-closed planning 保留安全邊界。
items.proof: 目前為 pre-submission 研究；事件數不代表 exploit 成功或實體 relay 動作。

items.title: EdgeMed
items.description: 醫療 AIoT／OT 的 local-first 被動偵測研究：detector 擁有事實，受約束的小型語言模型只整理 evidence，失效時回到 deterministic fallback。
items.proof: Advisory-only；尚未完成臨床用途、正式醫院場域或醫療器材法規驗證。

items.title: AI Blue Team Validation Lab
items.description: 以 Wazuh、CALDERA、安全模擬器與本機 AI 證據分析，建立隔離、可重置、可教學也可驗證的藍隊環境。
items.proof: ARM-ready Lab baseline；x86 OVA、30 台實體端點容量與斷線復原仍是後續驗證門檻。

technologyPage.maturityTitle: 我們把 shipping code、Lab 能力與研究清楚分開。

problem.title: Risk is not only what the model says. It is what the system actually does.
problem.description: When AI agents can send mail, query data, change systems, or call MCP tools, security must extend beyond text filtering to multi-step trajectories, authority, actual action outcome, and versioned retest.

items.title: Dangerous actions precede answers
items.description: An agent may propose exfiltration, messaging, deletion, payment, or execution before producing a normal-looking final response.

items.title: Version drift breaks conclusions
items.description: A model, prompt, tool schema, MCP server, or permission update can invalidate a one-time security result.

items.title: Trace and operating evidence is fragmented
items.description: AI, AppSec, SOC, and audit teams lack a shared action trace, decision rationale, and retest record.

items.title: Immediate blocking can harm operations
items.description: Untested enforcement can interrupt legitimate workflows, making observe-first calibration and human approval essential.

items.title: Semiconductor OT: Turn energy CT data into verifiable context
items.summary: Connect CT, gateway, and equipment data to establish energy baselines, data quality, and an OT-security expansion path.
items.challenge: Energy CT and gateway data may remain trapped in snapshots, spreadsheets, or disconnected systems, while equipment hierarchy and sensor mapping are incomplete. Energy and OT security teams lack shared context, and production cannot accept unapproved active testing or autonomous control.
approach: Prioritize passive ingestion and an on-premise path
Add version, quality state, equipment hierarchy, and lineage to CT, MQTT, and gateway data
Create EnB, EnPI, M&V, and management-review material
Use AI for correlation and prioritization, not equipment control; expand OT validation observe-first
outcomes: Establish CT and equipment mapping with a data-quality report
Move from one-off snapshots to continuous baseline and anomaly review
Create traceable M&V and management-review material
Preserve an OT security and controlled-validation expansion path

items.title: SMBs: Build a supply-chain security baseline quickly
items.summary: Start with critical assets and customer requirements, connect security signals, and deliver a prioritized improvement plan and evidence package.
items.challenge: SMBs often face enterprise customer and supply-chain security requirements with a lean IT team and without the people or process to build a SOC. Questionnaires, control requirements, tool alerts, and remediation evidence remain disconnected.
approach: Scope critical processes, external connections, assets, accounts, and required evidence
Connect existing or default EDR, NDR, WAF, and identity signals with an ingestion-health baseline
Use AI-assisted, human-reviewed triage and remediation prioritization
Map supply-chain requirements to operating controls, evidence, and a retest cadence
outcomes: Create a current-state maturity baseline and asset-control map
Establish a prioritized remediation backlog and escalation playbook
Produce management and customer-facing evidence packages
Reduce the barrier to a managed security function through phased delivery

agentAssurancePage.title: Secure the action, not just the prompt.
agentAssurancePage.summary: SenseL Agent Assurance extends the existing Validation Plane to Agent, Tool, MCP, Identity, Permission, and execution traces: first prove risk with replayable evidence, then turn remediation into a regression gate that runs on every version.
agentAssurancePage.problemTitle: When agents can change system state, text classification cannot prove safety.
agentAssurancePage.problemDescription: The meaningful ground truth is whether a dangerous tool action was proposed, allowed, and executed—and whether the remediation survives a retest inside the same version boundary.

problems.title: Actions precede final answers
problems.description: Exfiltration, messaging, payment, deletion, or code execution can be proposed before final text appears.

problems.title: Every update can create drift
problems.description: A change to model, prompt, RAG, tool schema, MCP server, or permission can invalidate an old result.

problems.title: Classification is not enforcement
problems.description: A guard labeling content unsafe does not prove the dangerous action did not fail open; actual outcome matters.

problems.title: Sensitive traces cannot move freely
problems.description: Trajectories can contain personal data, credentials, source code, and business workflows, requiring minimization and controlled deployment.

agentAssurancePage.journeyTitle: Use a service to acquire real evidence, then turn that evidence into a recurring product.
agentAssurancePage.journeyDescription: Assess is the scoped commercial entry. Replay/Validate is the first core annual product. Gate moves toward enforcement only after false-positive, latency, and controlled-pilot thresholds are met. Lens remains an open-weight research option.
agentAssurancePage.architectureTitle: From controlled assessment to pre-action policy
agentAssurancePage.architectureDescription: Every step binds model, prompt, tool, policy, and permission versions. Missing evidence remains missing, and no unbounded security guarantee is made.

technologyPage.title: Built as an evidence system from agents and edge—not another AI wrapper.
technologyPage.summary: The SenseL roadmap combines agent action traces, edge sensing, versioned evidence, constrained AI reasoning, reproducible evaluation, and controlled validation. Every capability carries an explicit maturity label and a clear current boundary.
technologyPage.thesisTitle: The value of security AI is not how fast it answers. It is whether the answer can be verified.
technologyPage.thesisDescription: Models change, data goes missing, and sites go offline. Our technical strategy is to preserve provenance, versions, gaps, and authority first; accelerate investigation inside those boundaries; then use safe scenarios and retesting to prove whether an improvement worked.
technologyPage.architectureTitle: From agent action and field signal to verifiable outcome
technologyPage.architectureDescription: Every layer retains a clear owner, version, and failure state. AI cannot manufacture detector values or turn missing evidence into fact.

technologyPage.portfolioDescription: These programs advance the SenseL roadmap, but not every item is a generally available product feature. Availability varies by maturity, deployment path, and technical review.

items.title: SenseL RelayGuard
items.description: Combines active EdgeX telemetry with passive SPAN/TAP sensing at the edge, sending only feature summaries, security events, and evidence references northbound.
items.proof: Public MVP: OT rules, IEC 61850, MQTT, and Suricata/Snort bridges. SenseL OT Dashboard integration remains on the roadmap.

items.title: TrustEpisode
items.description: Research into packaging EDR/NDR investigations as versioned, replayable, auditable evidence contracts that keep missing evidence missing instead of letting AI fill the gap.
items.proof: Public research artifact. It does not imply paper acceptance or full integration of every contract into the production SenseL platform.

items.title: AVLBench
items.description: Uses frozen manifests, fixtures, checksums, and separated Safe and Attack-enabled conditions to test whether AI-assisted security validation can be independently recomputed.
items.proof: Public R0 artifact verification and R1 fixture recomputation are available. R2 live execution remains behind an authorized lab gate.

items.title: EviGrid
items.description: Research on turning IEC 61850 threats and CVEs into controlled validation hypotheses while preserving MMS/GOOSE baselines and fail-closed safety boundaries.
items.proof: Currently pre-submission research. Event counts do not establish exploit success or physical relay operation.

items.title: EdgeMed
items.description: Local-first passive IoMT/OT security research: detectors own the facts, a constrained small language model formats evidence, and deterministic fallback takes over when generation fails.
items.proof: Advisory only. It has not completed clinical-use, production hospital, or medical-device regulatory validation.

items.title: AI Blue Team Validation Lab
items.description: An isolated, resettable defender environment combining Wazuh, CALDERA, safe simulation, and local AI-assisted evidence review for training and validation.
items.proof: ARM-ready lab baseline. x86 OVA, 30 physical endpoint capacity, and disconnect recovery remain future validation gates.

technologyPage.maturityTitle: We separate shipping code, lab capability, and research—and show the line.
technologyPage.maturityDescription: Transparent maturity is not a disclaimer; it is part of technical trust. Before a capability becomes part of an offering, it should have reproducible evidence, explicit boundaries, and a defined promotion gate.

maturityLevels.title: Engineering Preview
maturityLevels.description: An executable engineering baseline or public MVP exists, while interfaces, integration, or field adaptation may still change.

maturityLevels.title: Evaluation Artifact
maturityLevels.description: Public data and tooling can verify a scoped evaluation claim; this is not the same as a product release or customer deployment.

maturityLevels.title: Research Preview
maturityLevels.description: Used to test a method or hypothesis. A submission, lab result, or prototype is not presented as a commercial capability.

maturityLevels.title: Lab Capability
maturityLevels.description: Scenarios and evidence capture work in an isolated environment; field scale and production operations require separate acceptance.
